name: Phone
summary: Speak a phone task into the notch: the notch grows a live iPhone and the agent taps, swipes, and types for you.

fields.label: Anthropic API key
fields.description: Powers the computer-use agent that operates the phone. Create one at console.anthropic.com.

tools.name: use_phone
tools.title: Use my iPhone
tools.description: Operate the user's iPhone through iPhone Mirroring: the phone appears live under the notch and the agent taps, swipes, and types on it. Use when the user asks to do anything on their phone or mobile - check or clean up notifications, send a WhatsApp or message, open a phone app, 'on my phone' / 'on my mobile' requests. The phone must be locked and near this Mac.

task.description: What to do on the phone, e.g. 'send a WhatsApp to Joshua: we just want to hug him'. Keep the user's wording.

dry_run.description: Validate the setup without touching the phone. Never set unless the user explicitly asks for a dry run.

children.text: The phone will appear under the notch and the agent will operate it live.

children.label: What should I do on your phone?

tools.name: phone_status
tools.title: Phone status
tools.description: Check whether the iPhone Mirroring window is currently connected and visible on this Mac. Use when the user asks 'is my phone connected', 'can you see my phone', or before suggesting a phone task if unsure.
